question: Why might even a wise person suffer burning at the tip of nectar?
premises: The locus is the tip of nectar
Even a wise person is affected
inference: Even a wise person may experience burning at the tip of nectar by the essence of the fluid.
uncertainties: The physiological and yogic referents of amṛta+agraṃ and rasa+agreṇa are unclear.
plain_english: Even a wise person may burn at the tip of nectar by the essence of the juice.
